name: tamlul
description: Transcribe and annotate Hebrew conversations locally: speaker-attributed, timestamped, verbatim transcripts of meetings, interviews, calls and voice notes, with turns, overlaps, action items and summaries.

profile.title: Default profile
profile.description: meeting (default), voice-note, interview, ca, legal or auto. Sets the ASR revision and annotation defaults.

compute_type.title: CTranslate2 compute type
compute_type.description: auto (the pre-release decision recorded in models.json), int8 or float32.

diarization.title: Speaker diarization
diarization.description: on or off. Off skips pyannote entirely (no speaker layer).

models_dir.title: Model directory
models_dir.description: Where the multi-GB models are stored. Leave empty for the plugin data directory.
